description: One HUD Section 8 or assistance property with every contract on it: address, county, total units, HUD property category and financing type, FHA number, and per contract the number, program, status, effective date, both expiration dates, term, assisted units and rent-to-FMR ratio. Look up by contract number, HUD property ID, or property name within a state.

city.description: Optional city, to narrow a name search.

contract_number.description: HUD contract number, 11 characters, e.g. DE26M000010.

name.description: Property name or part of it, e.g. "Carvel Gardens" (needs "state").

state.description: Two-letter state code. Optional with a contract number.

name: get_property
title: Section 8 property and its contracts
